title: Open-Vocabulary 3D Object Detection with Co-Distillation Discovery and Dual Guidance Robust Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.19973v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recently, open-vocabulary 3D object detection (3D-OVD) has gained increasing attention for its ability to detect unseen objects in 3D scenes. Existing approaches typically adopt a two-stage pipeline that first discovers novel objects using foundation models and then trains a 3D-OVD model based on these discovered objects. Although effective, this pipeline often suffers from inaccurate localization and mismatched classification during the discovery stage, which subsequently limits the performance of the model training stage. To address these limitations, we advocate for improving both the reliability of novel object discovery and the robustness of model training, and propose an innovative framework. translated_title: 开放词汇3D物体检测：协同蒸馏发现与双重引导稳健训练
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19973v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：近年来，开放词汇3D物体检测（3D-OVD）因其在3D场景中检测未见物体的能力而受到越来越多的关注。现有方法通常采用两阶段流程，首先使用基础模型发现新物体，然后基于这些发现的物体训练3D-OVD模型。尽管有效，但该流程在发现阶段常常遭受不准确的定位和不匹配的分类问题，这随后限制了模型训练阶段的性能。为了解决这些限制，我们主张同时提高新物体发现的可靠性和模型训练的稳健性，并提出了一个创新框架。具体而言，对于可靠发现，我们的协同蒸馏策略通过应用匈牙利匹配，基于结合几何一致性、结构物体性和语义中心性的综合评分，来提炼高质量的新物体。
tldr: 本文提出了一种创新框架，通过协同蒸馏策略和双重引导稳健训练，同时提升开放词汇3D物体检测中新物体发现的可靠性和模型训练的稳健性，以解决现有两阶段流程中定位不准确和分类不匹配的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an innovative framework that enhances both the reliability of novel object discovery and the robustness of model training in open-vocabulary 3D object detection via co-distillation strategy and dual guidance robust training, addressing inaccurate localization and mismatched classification in existing two-stage pipelines.
